selection.summary: Issue #1241: on first usage of a context the window/index starts at 0, so a match at the first input position can yield an invalid (0) offset. Fix is to start references at 1 in the window initialization (ZSTD_window_init) in lib/compress/zstd_compress_internal.h, so first position is 1. Selected handles cover the window init/clear/update logic (h8 495-534, h10 536-555, full window struct range h0 615-694 and h7 640-699), plus the context/window usage call sites in zstd_compress.c (h2, h14, h15) and related usage in zstd_ldm.c and zstdmt_compress.c (h3, h4).

selection_posture: Explicit terminal handles bound to exact successful request/response, then unchanged native source projection and export; not archive union.
